healthCenter.title: Health center
healthCenter.intro: Every minute, the deep checks (database, hostd, edge, DNS, mail, workers) and the data disk of the node are followed, as well as the backup runs. The platform administrators are notified once per change of state — in the bell, by e-mail according to their preferences, and on the notification channels subscribed to these events.
healthCenter.loadFailed: The health center could not be loaded
healthCenter.saveFailed: The health center settings could not be saved
healthCenter.workersOff: Background workers are off on this panel (OBLIMINT_WORKERS=off): nothing is followed.
healthCenter.enabledHint: Off: the states are still followed and shown on the dashboard, nothing is sent.
healthCenter.confirmChecks: Checks before a change of state
healthCenter.confirmChecksHint: Consecutive checks (one per minute) needed before a component or the disk is declared down — and as many to declare it back. Avoids alerts on a single hiccup.
healthCenter.diskHint: The data disk of the node is low under either threshold (0 GiB: share only).

event.nodeDiskLow: Low disk space on the node
event.backupRecovered: A backup succeeds again after a failure

healthCenter.notCheckedYet: Not checked yet: the first pass runs about a minute after the start.
